$comment: Agent-plugin manifest — ARCHITECTURE.md §10.3. A host that can run a subprocess and read JSON lines can drive VibeGuard from this file alone.
name: vibeguard
description: Audit, repair, and harden vibe-coded applications toward production grade.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Read-only scan. Never writes to the target repository.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Apply only SAFE_AUTOFIX repairs, each validated and committed on a dedicated branch.

commands.name: ci
commands.description: Audit plus a severity gate. Exit 1 when the gate fails.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Re-render the last recorded scan without rescanning.

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Print the inferred architecture as mermaid or SVG. Discovery only, no rules.

exit_codes.0: ok, or below the CI threshold
exit_codes.1: findings at or above the fail-on threshold (ci mode)

artifacts.vibeguard-report.json: Canonical report, schema in docs/INTERFACES.md §8. Always written.
artifacts.vibeguard-report.html: Self-contained dashboard — no external requests of any kind.
artifacts..vibeguard/history/: One stored report per run; the input to the regression diff.
artifacts..vibeguard/repro/: Generated pytest repro tests, one per repro-verified repair.

events.$comment: One JSON object per line on stdout under --output jsonl: {"event": name, "ts": iso8601, "data": {...}}. The first ten names are normative (docs/INTERFACES.md §6); the rest are additive extensions.

privacy.notes: Built-in rules need no network and no model. `--local-only` refuses any AI provider that is not on this machine and skips adapters that contact a remote service; a non-local send is always announced as ai.external_send before it happens.
